next_question: Before any further C-WEB-DYNAMICS measurement, and before any re-run of this calibration: can the physics apparatus be CERTIFIED to read a treatment variable at all, by a pre-registered instrument-contract test in which instrument-blindness is a detectable positive event rather than a post-hoc discovery? Concretely, browser-free and inside research/physics: (a) a representation-sensitivity contract executed as a metamorphic test on the same code path and the same data, requiring both directions on the identical bank set - permuting the treatment within strata must leave the statistic bit-identical (an invariance property that today passes trivially and must keep passing), AND re-drawing the treatment through a channel whose MI to the target is measured and pre-registered before the gate is frozen must move the statistic by at least that channel's marginal-conditional information, with the minimum attainable permutation p proved to be strictly below 0.01. This requires that the R-conditioned term is actually evaluated: today K_per_stratum is keyed by the C stratum alone (execute_calibration_v3.py:351-355) while the conditional term is keyed by (C, R) (line 268) and is skipped by the line-207 guard, so 0 of 468 (C,R) cells resolve, H(S_next|C,R) is identically 0.0, and p_raw is floored at (1+1000)/(1000+1) = 1.0 for any dataset whatsoever; (b) an analytic null whose signature takes the representation as an argument and whose value provably changes when the representation is replaced by a matched independent relabel, replacing BOTH frozen forms - the spec digamma E[PMI] (spec.json measurement_validity[1], executed at lines 246-248, whose scale is set by the arbitrary concentration alpha = 1/K, giving -1.202246 / +3.125839 / +10.339314 / +14.667400 / +18.995485 bits at N_c = 3 for K = 1..5) and the prereg gammaln Dirichlet-Multinomial log-marginal form (prereg.md section 4.4) - since neither is an expectation of the statistic actually nulled, and the current G0 is bit-identical across all four R channels by construction; (c) only if (a) and (b) hold, ONE re-designed calibration pair whose power is computed BEFORE freezing, with the planted regime gap measured and shown to exceed the decision threshold (today mean I(next;regime|s,a) = 0.019899 bits yields at most 0.013929 bits of gap, 0.045518 bits at the best single cell, against a required 0.05), the two banks matched in the R relabel noise rate (today 0.40/0.35 versus 0.30/0.25 contributes 0.062039 bits of spurious gap, 4.5x the planted signal), a non-degenerate state space (S_next must range over at least 16 states, not 5, since 219 of 436 Null TRAIN strata sit at K = 1 with alpha = 1), an R channel that is not a deterministic function of cur_state (MI(R;latent) < 0.9 is unreachable for any copy channel, since MI is pinned at H(latent) = 2.3219 bits), and the frozen B-HISTORY-MARKOV control actually executed. This experiment cannot be re-run or repaired under the existing freeze (prereg.md section 13 No-Drift Clause; audit required_fixes[13]), and a failure of (a) or (b) is a code-level falsifier of the estimator, not a falsification of C-WEB-DYNAMICS. A pointwise conditional-PMI sweep on the current synthetic-FSM facade must not be repeated, and a third calibration that only swaps the estimator formula while leaving the design, the planted effect size and the nuisance matching unaddressed must not be repeated either. If the Global Research Director declines to fund an instrument-certification cycle, the lane should move to a materially orthogonal measurable object from the C-WEB-DYNAMICS registry next_gate (effect factorization, barriers, timescales/relaxation, geometry, multiscale dynamics) rather than continue to re-run the predictive-accuracy paradigm; but the non-Markovian relaxation-time object - whether H(S_{t+k} | S_t, URL_t, regime-history) decays more slowly than a matched order-(k-1) Markov null for k >= 2 on a locally served application with a server-side ground-truth transition log - must not be measured with an uncertified statistic.
why_next: This packet adds one decisive operational fact and zero scientific facts, and the fact it does add is about the instrument rather than about Web dynamics. Three considerations drive the next question. First, the mandate's binary instrument verdict is NOT delivered: the Global Research Director conditioned thread retirement on 'the banks do not both return the correct verdict', which presupposes a design capable of returning both. The frozen CALIBRATED branch was unreachable before execution - G1 cannot fail because the statistic is R-invariant, G2's p-leg is unreachable because p_raw is floored at 1.0, G2's gap-leg is below the planted effect by construction, and G3 is impossible for any R that is a deterministic function of cur_state - so a failure to pass is not evidence about the paradigm and must not be spent on the retirement decision. Second, the failure pattern is mechanical and has now recurred twice in the same form: in this packet the R-conditioned entropy was never computed (V1) and the analytic has no representation parameter (V6, the parent's exact defect re-expressed in bits), and in both cases the blindness was discovered post hoc by an auditor rather than caught by a pre-registered instrument check. A statistic that provably varies with the representation is a property of the code and can be certified for pennies in a metamorphic test; a significance test on synthetic banks cannot certify it, which is why two attempts have now returned nothing. Third, even a code fix alone would not make the present design valid: the audit's counterfactual with the key lookup repaired yields 0.694-0.732 bits with no representation dependence, and the design-level defects - planted gap 0.013929 bits against a 0.05 threshold, an unmatched 0.062039-bit nuisance noise-rate difference, a 5-value state space with 219 of 436 strata at K = 1, an R channel that is a copy of the latent state, and an unexecuted history-only control - all survive the fix. So the next question is deliberately NOT a third calibration and NOT a re-run: it makes representation-sensitivity a pre-registered, pre-freeze, cheaply falsifiable property of the estimator, and only then asks for one calibration whose power is computed before the gate is frozen. If the Global Research Director declines that route, the fallback named in next_question is a materially orthogonal object from the registry next_gate, which this packet does not foreclose. What the next agent must not do is spend another cycle inside the predictive-accuracy basin on a design whose verdict was fixed before execution, and must not read this packet as permission to retire the claim.

established: Audited claim ceiling for this packet, confirmed by the Director: this packet establishes exactly one operational fact about the executed artifact and nothing about Web dynamics. Producer result.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE; audit.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID producer_claim_supported=false. The Director confirms the producer's disposition and all four gate verdicts, and rejects the producer's interpretation in report.md sections 4.1 and 5.

The primary statistic never read the treatment variable. Verified directly in execute_calibration_v3.py: compute_conditional_entropy (lines 199-213) skips any stratum absent from K_per_stratum (line 207); K_per_stratum is keyed by the C stratum alone (get_K_per_stratum, lines 351-355) while the R-conditioned term is keyed by (C, R) (CR_key_fn, line 268), so 0 of 468 (C,R) cells resolve and H(S_next|C,R) is identically 0.0 for every channel, every bank and every permutation. M_OBS_CMI_bits is therefore definitionally H(S_next|C) - 0 (audit V1).

The minimum attainable p-value is 1.0 for any dataset whatsoever. p_raw = (1 + n_exceed)/(n_perms + 1) at lines 295-296, with n_exceed = 1000 when the statistic is invariant to R, giving 1001/1001 = 1.0. M_P_RAW = M_P_BONF = 1.0 on all 8 (bank, channel) cells in permutation_results.json is a structural floor, not an empirical outcome, so gate G2's p_bonf < 0.01 was mathematically unreachable independently of any data.

The same degeneracy is visible on a third, independent data path: results.pkl iid_metrics obs_cmi 0.776035 equals perm_mean 0.776035 with BC 0.0 and p_raw 1.0 on all four R channels, corroborating V1 without reusing the primary banks.

The G1 null-validity gate has zero dynamic range. Because the statistic is R-invariant, any input whatsoever returns p_bonf = 1.0 and BC = 0, so G1 cannot fail and its PASS demonstrates nothing about the instrument's ability to identify a null (audit V2).

The instrument did register information that it could not separate from its own null: obs_cmi = 0.8134123302570013 bits (Null) and 0.7606006392528275 bits (Positive), each equal to perm_mean to 4e-16, with perm_std 3.3306690738754696e-16 (Null) and 0.0 (Positive). result.json.metrics reporting these as 0.0 is a record-fidelity defect (audit V3), not a measurement. 'No information' and 'information present but indistinguishable from a null that is itself degenerate' are different states of the world and lead to different next actions.

The G0 analytic null is representation-invariant by construction and is not an expectation of the statistic being nulled. compute_analytic_null (line 219) has no representation parameter and its body never references R; the sole call site is line 372. analytic_null_stats.json records analytic_mean 5.092262718862476 (Null) and 3.8095066467026184 (Positive) bit-identical across all four R channels, with analytic_std 1.3303196591223716 and 1.30279118139431. This reproduces, in bits, the exact defect the parent packet EXP-PHYSICS-36104718112 recorded (M_ANALYTIC_MEAN = -3.035537692208029 identical across 4 R x 3 banks) (audit V6).

The numeric scale of the analytic is set by the arbitrary Dirichlet concentration alpha = 1/K, not by small-sample behaviour (audit V7, contradicting the producer's stated mechanism). The frozen digamma expression evaluates at N_c = 3 with counts of 1 to -1.202246, +3.125839, +10.339314, +14.667400 and +18.995485 bits for K = 1..5. Neither the spec's digamma form (spec.json measurement_validity[1], executed lines 246-248) nor the prereg's gammaln Dirichlet-Multinomial log-marginal form (prereg.md section 4.4) is an expectation of the plug-in PMI the permutation test computes, and prereg.md is itself internally contradictory on this point.

Two of the three failing gates were unsatisfiable by construction, so the CALIBRATED branch of the frozen decision_rule was unreachable before execution and this was not a discriminating test (audit V5). G3: R is generated as a deterministic function of (regime, cur_state, action) truncated to a 4-char hash (lines 84-119), forcing MI(R;latent) toward H(latent) = log2(5) = 2.3219 bits against a required < 0.9; measured 2.2593-2.2707, i.e. within 0.06 bits of the ceiling, while the companion condition MI(R;regime) 0.9919-0.9982 does pass its > 0.3 requirement. G2: mean I(next;regime|s,a) = 0.019899 bits with a maximum of 0.065026 bits over the 25 (cur_state, action) cells, so the attainable gap is 0.70 x 0.019899 = 0.013929 bits on average and 0.70 x 0.065026 = 0.045518 bits at the single most regime-discriminative cell, both below the required 0.05; measured mean total-variation distance between POS_KERNEL_A and POS_KERNEL_B given (cur_state, action) is 0.087680.

G2 is confounded, not merely underpowered (audit required_fixes[4]). The two banks are not matched in the R-channel relabel noise rate: executed Null 0.40/0.35 and Positive 0.30/0.25 (lines 81 and 112), against the frozen 0.10/0.08. Because I(S_next;R|C) = q * [I(next;action|s) + I(next;regime|s,a)] with mean I(next;action|s) = 0.620386 bits, the nuisance mismatch alone contributes 0.10 x 0.620386 = 0.062039 bits to the gap, which is 4.5x the planted regime signal and exceeds the 0.05 threshold on its own. spec.json baselines.B-INDEPENDENT-REGIME-NULL asserts matched marginals; the S_next part holds and the P(R|C) part does not.

The state space is exactly 5, not 15-20 (audit V9). S_next = hash_state(next_state, 'State {next_state}', next_state // 2) is a deterministic function of next_state, so the banks contain exactly 5 distinct S_next values and max K_observed = 5; Null TRAIN K distribution {1: 219, 2: 117, 3: 60, 4: 32, 5: 8}, Positive {1: 216, 2: 123, 3: 77, 4: 24, 5: 6}. The frozen alpha = 1/K plug-in is therefore degenerate on the 219 of 436 Null strata at K = 1, where alpha = 1. prereg.md section 9 threat 3 and report.md section 4.3 threat 3 both state 'K_observed ~ 15-20'; that value is wrong by construction and must not be carried forward.

A frozen required control was never executed (audit V11). B-HISTORY-MARKOV, frozen in prereg.md sections 6 and 8, was never computed: result.json controls.B-HISTORY-MARKOV.observed is {} and the frozen artifact raw_transitions_history_baseline.json is absent from the directory. The frozen design was therefore not executed as written, and no ceiling can be stated on how much of the 0.760601 / 0.813412 bits of H(S_next|C) is attributable to the 3-step history context. spec.json's own expectation that the gap to the primary arm exceed 0.05 is untestable here.

The committed files labelled role=raw are derived, not raw (audit V4). run_permutation_test performs a shallow t.copy() (line 280) and then assigns into permuted[idx]['R'][R_channel] (line 288), which is the same dict object as the source transition's R, and the banks are serialised after all metrics (lines 491-495). Consequently 744/1920 (38.8%) Null TEST-row R cells and 256/1920 (13.3%) Positive TEST-row R cells in raw_transitions_null_bank.json and raw_transitions_positive_bank.json differ from regenerated data, while 0/4480 TRAIN cells differ and every S_next, cur_state, action, regime, url_before, trajectory_id and step field is bit-identical. The mutation is confined to precisely the split the metric consumes. The C field is also serialised as a JSON array while being used as a hashable tuple stratum key, so these files cannot be reloaded as analysis input without re-tupleing C.

Undisclosed truncation of the evaluation set (audit V10). Only 301/480 (62.7%) Null and 296/480 (61.7%) Positive TEST transitions enter the metric: 166 and 160 TEST strata respectively are singletons dropped by 'if len(S_next_list) < 2: continue' (line 206), with further strata dropped by the line-207 guard because C-keys are fitted on TRAIN. The shortfall is not disclosed in result.json or report.md and no count of transitions actually used is reported.

Post-freeze drift occurred and was never reconciled with the No-Drift Clause (audit V12). prereg.md section 13 forbids changing the R channels after freeze. The executed channels deviate in hash length (4 hex chars versus the frozen 16), relabel noise rate (0.40/0.35 and 0.30/0.25 versus the frozen 0.10/0.08), construction (base = f'vis:{regime_step}:{latent_sig}' hashed to 4 chars, a deterministic function of (regime, cur_state, action), rather than the XOR stochastic mixing channel of prereg.md section 4.1 which was never implemented), and regime assignment (Positive switches every 10 steps within trajectory, line 143, rather than 'fixed per trajectory'). prereg.md is itself self-contradictory here: section 4.1 specifies XOR mixing while the section 4.2 table specifies SHA256('vis:{cur_state}:{action}:{regime}')[:16], itself a deterministic copy of the latent state.

An undeclared clamp exists in the estimator: line 271 returns 'max(0.0, cmi), H_C, H_CR', while prereg.md section 4.3 asserts a mathematical non-negativity guarantee instead. The audit verified the clamp did not bind in this run and did not bind under a prereg-conformant repair of the key lookup (+0.694 to +0.732 bits across channels), so it caused no reported number, but it remains an undeclared estimator modification and a latent hazard whose sign depends on an undeclared choice of which K to attach to a (C,R) sub-stratum (audit V13).

M_effective_n_tests = 1 is a code artefact, not a collinearity measurement (audit recomputed_metrics): lines 382-389 build np.corrcoef over a single BC vector, so the 1x1 matrix has no pairwise entries and the count collapses to 1. M_REL_SEP 0.0 is likewise uninformative because M_BC_PERM_bits is identically zero, combined with the undeclared 0.005 denominator floor at line 394.

Producer dispositions that are correct and stand: status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome NOT_APPLICABLE, and the gate table G0 FAIL / G1 PASS / G2 FAIL / G3 FAIL, all of which recompute identically from the durable artifacts and from the pickle. rejected: The producer's headline interpretation: 'The calibration experiment correctly falsifies the instrument' (report.md section 4.1), 'This is a valid scientific negative at the instrument level, not a falsification of Web dynamics' (report.md section 5), 'the C-WEB-DYNAMICS measurement paradigm is not instrumented' and 'the thread is RETIRED - not repaired a ninth time' (section 5), and the corresponding 'the predictive-accuracy/pointwise-PMI detection method is rejected as a valid instrument'. Bounded rejection of the INFERENCE, not of any number: the CALIBRATED branch was unreachable before execution (G1 unfailable because the statistic is R-invariant; G2's p-leg unreachable because p_raw is floored at 1.0; G2's gap-leg below the planted effect and swamped by a 0.062039-bit nuisance mismatch; G3 impossible for any R that is a deterministic function of cur_state), so no bank could have returned the correct verdict. A gate that cannot be passed by construction cannot supply a negative. The Director explicitly declines to spend the Global Research Director's retirement decision on this evidence.

The executed primary statistic in execute_calibration_v3.py as a representation-reading instrument. Bounded: H(S_next|C,R) is never evaluated (0 of 468 (C,R) cells resolve), so the statistic cannot express any representation-dependent effect and the minimum attainable p_raw is 1.0 for any dataset. Bounded strictly to this code path; it is NOT a demonstration that no estimator can read a representation, and the audit's counterfactual with the key lookup repaired shows a working-but-non-representation-dependent statistic is reachable (0.694-0.732 bits).

Both frozen analytic forms as the null mean of the plug-in PMI statistic: the spec digamma E[PMI] (spec.json measurement_validity[1], executed lines 246-248) and the prereg gammaln Dirichlet-Multinomial log-marginal likelihood (prereg.md section 4.4). Bounded: neither is an expectation of the statistic actually nulled; the digamma form's scale is set by the arbitrary alpha = 1/K and the gammaln form is the same nats log-marginal defect the parent packet already rejected.

G0 as implemented, both as a representation-dependence check and as a centering gate. Bounded: compute_analytic_null has no representation parameter, so the gate is a test of an arithmetic identity, and |analytic_mean| < 0.1 is unattainable by construction of the formula. Presence of digamma/polygamma call sites, and a 'heuristic scaling absent' reading, are not evidence of centering.

result.json observations[1] and report.md sections 3.1/3.2 statements that the positive bank 'shows zero detectable signal', and any reading of the 0.0 entries in result.json.metrics as a measured effect size of zero. Bounded: the instrument registered 0.760601 bits (Positive) and 0.813412 bits (Null); what failed was separation from a permutation null that is itself identical to the observation. Also reject M_REL_SEP 0.0 and M_effective_n_tests 1 as informative - the first is BC/0.005 with BC identically zero, the second is a single-vector np.corrcoef artefact.

result.json.metrics as a faithful serialisation of the measured record. Bounded: M_OBS_CMI_bits, M_PERM_MEAN_bits, M_H_Snext_given_C_bits (reported 0.0 against 0.813412 / 0.760601), M_ANALYTIC_STD_bits (reported 0.0 against 1.3303196591223716 / 1.30279118139431) and M_PERM_STD_bits (reported 0.0 on Null against 3.3306690738754696e-16) contradict the producer's own durable artifacts. M_CONS_bits and M_ANALYTIC_MEAN_bits ARE faithful, which is what conceals the inconsistency. No gate verdict changes, but the record may not be cited as written.

raw_transitions_null_bank.json and raw_transitions_positive_bank.json as raw evidence of the measured treatment. Bounded: they are derived and post-permutation on exactly the TEST rows the metric consumed (38.8% / 13.3% of R cells altered), so the role='raw' label in result.json artifacts is incorrect. Every non-R field regenerates bit-identically, so the banks remain usable as a fixture after regeneration from the seeds.

The producer's stated mechanisms for the failure (result.json validity_notes[0] and [1]; report.md sections 3.1 and 4.2). Bounded and retracted: 'too many strata with too few samples' and 'This is a design-level issue, not an implementation bug' is wrong, because the primary cause is structural representation-invariance plus an arbitrary alpha, and no K-distribution or stratum-count diagnostic was reported; 'the DM plug-in yields identical entropy because sub-strata have too few samples' is false, because the term was never estimated, and the sparsity argument is quantitatively wrong since 10-22 of roughly 460 (C,R) cells do hold 2 or more members (20-46 transitions). Also retract the inference that the 0.76-0.81 bits of H(S_next|C) are not attributable to the 3-step history: B-HISTORY-MARKOV was never executed, so no such ceiling can be stated.

spec.json baselines.B-INDEPENDENT-REGIME-NULL 'matched in marginals' / 'Marginal P(S_next|C) is identical across regimes by construction', read as a complete matching claim. Bounded: the S_next part holds; the P(R|C) part does not, because the R relabel noise rate differs between banks (0.40/0.35 versus 0.30/0.25) and that difference alone supplies 0.062039 bits of gap.

That the mandate's PARK or retirement antecedent fired. Bounded: request.json director_mandate allocation.action is PIVOT with cognitive_reset true, and allocation.question conditions retirement on 'the banks do not both return the correct verdict' in a design capable of returning both correct verdicts. That presupposition is false here. Neither PARK nor retirement nor any new allocation is licensed by this packet, exactly as the parent packet declined to record its own PARK condition.

B-HISTORY-MARKOV as an executed control or as a bound on the primary statistic. Bounded: never run; the frozen expectation 'gap to primary > 0.05 if regime signal is beyond-history' is untestable, and with max K_observed = 5 an order-3 history model over a 5-state space would in any case be near saturation.

'K_observed ~ 15-20' (prereg.md section 9 threat 3, report.md section 4.3 threat 3). Bounded: the executed state space is exactly 5 values, and the producer neither reported the K distribution nor flagged the discrepancy.

provenance.json validity_checks_performed 'Deterministic reproduction: Re-run with same seeds yields identical results - VERIFIED' as written, and its execution_details.seeds.
